L10: Reset behavior: enable bit cleared; transmit-empty flag set; receive-flag cleared after reset.
L10: Master mode transmission: write to data register + clock-cycle delay + N edges + receive-flag set.
L10: Slave mode transmission: select line goes LOW + N edges from master + receive-flag set after last edge.
L10: Mode fault / collision detection.
L10: All clock polarity/phase combinations.
L10: MSB-first vs LSB-first byte ordering.
L10: Bidirectional mode (single data pin).
L10: Receive overrun (flag-serviced-too-late).
L10: Baud rate divisor sweep.
L10: Wait/Stop mode behavior.
L16: Every command shall be decoded from CKE / CS# / RAS# / CAS# / WE# at the rising edge of CK.
L16: RESET# shall be HIGH during normal operation; LOW only at power-up (≥ 200 µs) or reset-with-stable-power (≥ 100 ns).
L16: Initialization shall follow the 12-step sequence ending with MRS + ZQCL + tDLLK + tZQinit.
L16: MR0-MR3 shall be re-programmed after every power-up.
L16: All MRS / REF / SRE / ZQCL / ZQCS commands shall be issued only when all banks are precharged and tRP is satisfied.
L16: tMRD and tMOD shall be honoured between MRS commands.
L16: Refresh average interval ≤ tREFI; rolling max ≤ 9 × tREFI.
L16: After Self-Refresh exit, one extra REF shall be issued before re-entering Self-Refresh.
L16: tFAW shall be honoured.
L16: Read bursts return DQ at RL = AL + CL; write bursts accept DQ at WL = AL + CWL.
L16: tCCD ≥ 4 nCK between successive column commands.
L16: ZQCL at end of init; ZQCS periodically.
L16: VREFCA = VDD/2, VREFDQ = VDDQ/2 nominal; stable in Self-Refresh.
L16: Differential CK / DQS AC swing ≥ 0.350 V; Vix ±150 mV of VDD/2.
